prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile web app composition, portrait 390×844, iPhone Safari viewport
Primary request: design option A for Russian app «Моя рецептурная — XYKA PRO», a personal offline hookah mix recipe workshop. Visitor job is immediately clear: choose flavor direction and verbal strength, then tap «Подобрать» or «Случайный микс».
Structure in order: thin 18+ nicotine notice strip; compact title and pantry status «Моя полка · 26 из 26»; dominant first-viewport workshop selector made as a large paper recipe sheet with eight flavor-direction tabs and five verbal strength chips (no numeric strength); large plum CTA «Подобрать» with secondary «Случайный микс»; below the fold, first real result preview named «Ягодный чифир» showing 3 components and percentages, origin stamp «Авторский», favorites icon, and a glimpse of taste timeline.
Style/medium: premium realistic UI mockup, Russian editorial recipe notebook meets flavor laboratory; tactile but clean; all core controls look implementable in semantic HTML/CSS.
Color palette: warm parchment #F3EBDD, ink #25221F, plum #702F4D, raspberry #B94E6E, tea green #536B58, muted brass #B48A52.
Materials/textures: restrained paper grain, thin ink rules, small stamped labels, one subtle coordinate grid; no glossy glassmorphism.
Typography: confident condensed editorial display for title, highly readable system sans for controls; Russian text exactly as provided where visible.
Text (verbatim where visible): «МОЯ РЕЦЕПТУРНАЯ», «XYKA PRO», «Что хочется сегодня?», «Направление», «Крепость», «Десертное», «Ягодное», «Чайное», «Необычное», «Лёгкая», «Средне-лёгкая», «Средняя», «Крепкая», «Подобрать», «Случайный микс», «Ягодный чифир», «Авторский».
Composition/framing: phone screen only, straight-on, edge-to-edge app, show enough below first action to prove recipe-card system; no device frame, no hand, no photo background.
Constraints: strengths are words only; no numbers, no /10, no slider; touch targets generous; no alcohol, mint, ice imagery; no tobacco product photos or commercial branding; no invented ratings; no English UI except XYKA PRO.
Avoid: generic ecommerce grid, generic bento dashboard, neon, black luxury hookah aesthetic, excessive rounded cards, gradients, tiny text, horizontal overflow, poster-like illustration, watermark.
